findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. 

A food employee was observed to wash hands, acquire a paper towel, turn off the faucet with the clean barrier and then use the paper towel to wipe their hands. Education was conducted to correct. Ensure proper hand washing procedures take place at all times.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: The top of the pizza oven is observed to have an accumulation of food debris/soil residues. Ensure this surface is cleaned and sanitized then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to prevent this accumulation.
4-602.13:  NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The air vents in the kitchen and the floors are observed to have an accumulation of soil residues/dust residues. Ensure these surfaces receive proper attention to allow the surfaces to be clean. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The caulking at the triple sink is observed to be in a state needing repair. Remove the old caulking and replace it with a fresh seal that is smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The fan on top of the fridge is observed to have an accumulation of dust and soil residue. Ensure this surface is cleaned to prevent potential contamination of areas in the kitchen.
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The caulking at the triple sink is observed to be in a state needing repair. Remove the old caulking and replace it with a fresh seal that is smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed the hand washing sink in the kitchen to be slow draining and the mop sink faucet to be dripping at the time of the inspection. Repair plumbing so sink drains effectively and faucet does not leak.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment:
Containers of cleaner were stored above the 3-pan sink.  The containers were put on the floor below the sink to CORRECT the violation.  They should be kept in a location where any accidental drips or spills will not contaminate equipment, food, single service items, dish washing water, etc.

750-1310 All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.citation_text: 750.120 - Most potentially hazardous foods in the top portion of the prep cooler were above 41F (cheese 44F-47F; chicken 46F; tomato sauce 50F; pepperoni 43F-50F). Ice packs were being used to hold foods cold but bagged ice was also added to the top portion to help maintain colder temperatures. After ice was added temperatures for a few products were checked and foods were at cooler temperatures (ham 41F; chicken 44F; tomato sauce 44F-46F). Any leftover potentially hazardous foods will be discarded at the close of business. Until prep cooler is able to maintain products are 41F/below use ice baths rather than ice packs to help maintain proper temperature. (see general comments) **Tomato sauce was opened from a can prior to inspector's arrival**

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) laundry baskets below 3 part sink (dried food splash/general soil); B) fan covers in 3 door cooler; C) top shelves in 3 door cooler; & E) bottom inside warmer (crumbs). Clean the above items and all non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.citation_text: 750.1170 - Door sweep on the front door was damaged and had a gap underneath where light was visible. Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of pests. Replace the sweep and make any other necessary repairs to ensure the front door is tight fitting and vermin proof.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: Did not observe a thermometer in the freezer.  Provide a conspicuously located thermometer in each cooler.  Corrected:  thermometer placed in the freezer.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed a build-up of soil in the plastic container holding the sanitizer test kits.  Clean the holder and maintain clean.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment:
Observed sanitizer in spray bottles without a proper label.  Keep secondary containers labeled.  Corrected:  bottles labeled.
750-1300 Containers of poisonous or toxic materials necessary for the maintenance of the establishment shall be labeled in accordance with law. Properly label containers of toxic substances.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment: Observed cooked pasta and Italian beef without a proper label.  Label potentially hazardous food that you prepare, with the time and date of preparation and storage.

findings.title: Foods properly cooled
findings.comment: Observed a roaster pan of italian beef in the reach in cooler at 49F.  The food was labeled 1/13/10.  Food was discarded.  Cool potentially hazardous food to 70F in two hours and to 41F or less in four additional hours.  Corrected - food was discarded.
